description: This file defines the Http2HeaderBlock class, which provides a key-value map for storing SPDY/HTTP2 headers, including internal classes for managing header values and iteration. It includes methods for inserting, erasing, and accessing headers, and manages memory for header storage.

classes.name: Http2HeaderBlock
classes.description: A class representing a key-value map for SPDY/HTTP2 headers, preserving insertion order and managing header storage efficiently.

classes.name: Http2HeaderBlock::HeaderValue
classes.description: A helper class for managing individual header value fragments and their memory.

classes.name: Http2HeaderBlock::iterator
classes.description: An iterator class for traversing header entries in Http2HeaderBlock.

classes.name: Http2HeaderBlock::ValueProxy
classes.description: A proxy class for accessing and modifying header values within Http2HeaderBlock.

methods.name: Http2HeaderBlock::operator[]
methods.description: Provides access or insertion of a header value by key.

methods.name: Http2HeaderBlock::erase
methods.description: Removes a header entry by key.

methods.name: Http2HeaderBlock::clear
methods.description: Clears all headers and releases memory.

methods.name: Http2HeaderBlock::insert
methods.description: Inserts or replaces a header entry.

methods.name: Http2HeaderBlock::AppendValueOrAddHeader
methods.description: Appends to an existing header value or adds a new header.
